data.name: Monk of the Four Winds
data.description: The monk of the four winds is connected to the natural world in a way few other creatures-even other monks- can hope to match. He can call upon the elements and the spirits of the world in times of need, and as he nears his goal of perfection, he gains the ability to slow down time and even defeat death itself. A monk of the four winds has the following class features.
